sources_read: .qc-cache/coldwater-strict-2026-10-02-r10/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx (Quality Checks row 28 = check 27; Internal Quality Checks row 28 incl. E28 sign-in annotation)
.qc-cache/coldwater-strict-2026-10-02-r10/rules/projects/webdev-task-template (file list compared; task prompts and criteria are task-specific)
evidence: Criterion -> requirement map built for all 54 criteria (1 render gate, 2 constraint gates, 42 functional with weight sum 58.5, 6 polish, 3 visual). 50 map cleanly to a quoted public requirement or an ordinary professional default: e.g. two-space nesting (ui.md:15), whole-line Tab on an in-line selection and the column-zero exclusion (ui.md:7), Alt+Click and Ctrl/Cmd+Click carets (ui.md:9), Replace current advancing and self-containing replacement (ui.md:11), five distinct JS token treatments also distinct from ordinary names (ui.md:13), disabled Undo/Redo (ui.md:9), focus return after Format/Undo/Redo/replacement/Save (ui.md:17), unsaved marker (ui.md:17), fetch to own routes and outside addresses must fail (security.md:3), restore retry idempotence (behaviour.md:13), live refresh within about five seconds, graded with a ten-second allowance (behaviour.md:11). No criterion requires sign-in, an exact label, an exact route, a fixed colour or a CSS class; functional/prompt.md:21-22 tells the judge to match controls by purpose and not guess routes. Instances found: (1) tests/scored/functional/judge.toml:236 cw_error_message_and_line (weight 1.0): 'For each of these two failures the app console must show the authored message and the one-based line number'. (2) tests/scored/functional/judge.toml:245 cw_promise_rejection_message_and_line (weight 1.5): 'For both unhandled cases the app console must show the authored message text and the one-based line number'. The public requirement, behaviour.md:3, says only 'Show a useful error message with a one-based line number for a thrown error ... and a Promise rejection that nothing handles' and names no location, while policy.md:3 says 'You may choose the layout, labels, routes, database schema and error wording'. The same criterion at line 236 words its syntax-error leg location-free ('a visible error must be shown'), and lines 281, 299, 308 use 'a visible ... reason', so the console-only wording is not a deliberate house rule. (3) tests/scored/polish/judge.toml:23 cw_controls_keyboard_and_focus: 'must be reachable with Tab or Shift+Tab'; ui.md:17 asks only 'Label controls clearly and show keyboard focus' plus a shown keyboard way out of the editor. Keyboard reachability is a professional default, the Tab-only mechanism is not. (4) Lower-risk wording, recorded as observations not defects: judge.toml:371 asks history inspection to show 'exact title, filename and source' of a revision whereas behaviour.md:13 says only that inspection is read-only (the fixture varies only the source, so impact is small); judge.toml:137 counts 'a fourth Next must wrap to the first', which is off by one for an app that selects the first match while the search text is typed, though the listed fail conditions do not cover that case. Run evidence: the scripted golden passes both error criteria on these bytes (results/runtime.json) and the hosted Oracle run on an earlier candidate scored Functional 41/41, so the golden is not false-failed; no run exercises a conforming alternative, and no configured judge run exists for these bytes.
counterexample: Conforming alternative that fails: an app that reports uncaught errors and unhandled rejections in a dedicated error banner or status strip beside the preview ('Error: boom-417 (line 4)') and keeps its console pane for console.* output only. It satisfies behaviour.md:3 and policy.md:3, yet a judge applying judge.toml:236 and :245 literally fails both criteria because the message and line are not in 'the app console': 2.5 of 58.5 functional weight, about 2.6 percent of the total reward at the 0.6 functional share. Second alternative: a toolbar built on the ARIA toolbar pattern (one Tab stop, arrow keys between Run, Stop, Save and Format, each with a visible focus ring) fails polish/judge.toml:23, one of six polish criteria, about 3.3 percent of the total reward. Broken app that passes: none found for this row; the wording errs only toward over-strictness.
suggested_fix: In functional/judge.toml:236 and :245 replace 'the app console must show' with 'the app must visibly show, in its console or in an error or status area,' and keep the message and line-number demands. In polish/judge.toml:23 replace 'reachable with Tab or Shift+Tab' with 'reachable with the keyboard alone (Tab, Shift+Tab, or arrow keys inside a control group)'. Optionally, at judge.toml:371 require only the revision's exact source in the inspection leg, and at :137 say that a first match already selected by typing the search text counts as the first visit. Any edit makes a new candidate that needs re-freezing.
